items.title: File an objection (Einspruch) against the fine
items.action: If you disagree with the fine, file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or in person at the Bußgeldstelle by the deadline shown by the app.
items.consequence: If you do not object in time, the fine notice becomes final (rechtskräftig) and the full amount must be paid.

items.action: Pay the total amount of €132.00 to the given IBAN, but only once the notice has become final (no objection filed) and within two weeks after that.

data.title: Bußgeldbescheid – speeding fine of €132.00
data.summary: Kreis Beispielborken's Bußgeldstelle issued a Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) to Johanna Beispielacker for driving 23 km/h over the 100 km/h limit on 5 October 2026, setting a total of €132.00 (€100 fine, €28.50 fee, €3.50 delivery costs) and 1 point in the Fahreignungsregister. The letter was formally delivered (zugestellt) on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official traffic fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) from the county's traffic fine office for speeding. You can object (Einspruch) in writing or in person — the app shows the deadline, counted from the day the letter was formally delivered. If you do not object, the notice becomes final and the €132.00 must then be paid within two weeks after that — do not pay before it is final. The information session mentioned is optional and free. If you're unsure whether to object, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsrechtsanwalt) or the ADAC before the deadline shown by the app runs out.
